response.original_title: How Do I Add a Cabin to My Icon of the Seas Cruise?
response.overview: [Complete 2026 Guide] How Do I Add a Cabin to My Icon of the Seas Cruise?  To add an additional cabin or stateroom to an existing Icon of the Seas cruise booking, you must call customer service or your travel agent directly, as room additions cannot be completed online or through the mobile app 1-866-254-7549 (US) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK).  Steps to Add a Cabin Contact Customer Service: Call Royal Caribbean Customer Support at 1-866-254-7549 (US) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK).  Provide Booking Details: Have your existing reservation or booking number  1-866-254-7549 (US) ready, along with the full legal names, dates of birth, and required travel details for the guests staying in the new cabin.  Ask the representative to link your reservations so your group stays close together for dining and onboard activities 1-866-254-7549 (US) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK).
